title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.
